accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged materials are available at the discretion of RAC.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: The John D. Rockefeller, Jr. papers, Garden Plans are arranged by creator.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection contains planting plans and landscape design sketches for gardens on the estates of John D. Rockefeller Jr. It includes plans for the gardens at Pocantico Hills, New York; The Eyrie in Seal Harbor, Maine; and small set of plans for the Rose Garden at the New York Botanical Garden. The collection includes original drawings as well as reproductions.
